sources.title: EF Core migrations overview
sources.finding: Migrations are source-controlled incremental schema changes with applied-history tracking; use a separate project/design-time factory when appropriate.

sources.title: Applying EF Core migrations
sources.finding: Inspect and test migrations; use a separate deployment identity, migration bundle for automation, reviewed SQL for DBA-controlled execution, and do not embed production connection strings.

sources.title: EF Core 10 release notes
sources.finding: EF Core 10 is the .NET 10 LTS-aligned release.

decision: Use the locked EF Core 10 and Npgsql 10-compatible PostgreSQL foundation, forward-only immutable migrations, a separate migration execution boundary, and operator-run local rehearsal without committed credentials.
limitations: No Product/domain model or migration is authorized in P0-008 refinement.
No database container, migration command, or production deployment was run during R&D.
